capabilities: browse and manage files across all local vaults in a three-pane UI
edit and preview notes with image, PDF, audio and video support
full-text search across all vaults with highlighted snippets
copy notes between vaults while keeping originals
switch vaults by self-installing into the target vault
extras: Desktop only (relies on Node file access and the obsidian:// protocol). First use in each vault requires manually turning off Restricted mode. The built-in editor lacks wikilink autocomplete and CodeMirror features. Full reference lives inside the plugin's settings and in external guide links.
problem: Obsidian opens one vault per window, so working across several vaults means switching windows and reloading each time.
summary: Workbench UI that browses, previews and edits notes across all local Obsidian vaults in one window, installing itself into a vault when you switch.
